pages.title: Entangled Photon Pair
pages.text: Two photons born together and described by a single shared quantum state, so that measuring the polarisation of one fixes the other no matter how far apart they are. No signal travels between them; the correlation was there from the start. In the hand the pair is a soft double glint that never quite lines up with itself.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding Virtual Photons from the quantum foam into the Quantum Entangler, I noticed some were promoted to real light in pairs. Every pair I measured was perfectly anticorrelated. Bell would have enjoyed the tally sheets.
